title: 18-year-old Texas student trains da Vinci robot to remove tumours; succeeds in 3 of 4 tests
summary_full: A brilliant eighteen-year-old student has engineered a cutting-edge framework designed for surgical robots. Utilizing a simulation strategy, this innovative system instructs robots on autonomous tumor excision. Tested on a da Vinci surgical platform alongside gel models, it achieved success by removing tumors in three out of four trials. This pioneering research paves the way for the future of medical robotics.
